trailhead.label: Boé gondola car park, Corvara, the board’s start

cautions: The path runs beside a fast mountain stream: keep your dog out of the water.
Boulder field below the Sella walls: watch for loose stones.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Boé gondola car park, Corvara, the board: Parcheggio della cabinovia Boé, Corvara, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.The path runs beside a fast mountain str: Il sentiero corre accanto a un impetuoso torrente di montagna: tieni il cane fuori dall'acqua.
textIt.Boulder field below the Sella walls: wat: Campo di massi sotto le pareti del Sella: attenzione ai sassi instabili.
